messages:
jess: Heads-up — onboarding ACME into a private VPC tomorrow morning. Quick checklist: where do engs look for that customer's Prom metrics, Grafana dashboards, and traces/logs? cc @miguel @anita
miguel: For metrics: customers should remote_write to prometheus-relay.redwood.svc:9090 (our ingest relay). On our side metrics end up in the TSDB partition labeled cluster=acme-<id>. Grafana folder (read-only): https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abcd1234/customer-acme — dashboards + panels for request_latency, tok_per_sec, and kv-cache-hit
anita: Traces -> OTLP -> tempo/jaeger backend at otlp-collector.redwood.internal:55680. Logs can be forwarded via fluent-bit -> our lumberjack elastic endpoint or via OTLP if they prefer. I'll paste the runbook with endpoints: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OBS/Private+VPC+Obs+Endpoints
jess: Awesome — do you have a sample promtail/fluent-bit config I can share with their infra team? They specifically asked about sending OTLP from their collector
miguel: promtail -> loki is still common for syslogs; here's a minimal promtail snippet to share:
```
server:
  http_listen_port: 9080
positions:
  filename: /var/log/promtail.pos
clients:
  - url: "http://loki-ingest.redwood.internal:3100/loki/api/v1/push"
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: system
    static_configs:
      - targets:
          - localhost
        labels:
          job: varlogs
          __path__: /var/log/*.log
```
anita: If they want OTLP directly from their collector, this is a minimal collector pipeline. Make sure they set service.name=acme and add attributes: env=prod, deployment=private-vpc
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      http: {}
exporters:
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: "https://otlp-collector.redwood.internal:4318"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlphttp]
```
lexi: For alerting — what's safe to enable initially so SRE doesn't get spammed? e.g., scrape failures, card spikes
sre_oncall: Start conservative: (1) prom_discovered_targets < 80% for 5m -> page (2) scrape_error_rate > 1% for 10m -> page (3) scrape_duration_seconds 95th > 10s -> warn to slack first (4) metric cardinality growth > 20%/24h -> ticket to eng. Put noisy per-customer alerts to #eng-observability (ops only) for first week. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/SRE/Private+VPC+Alerting
jess: Perfect. I'll send ACME the promtail + OTLP examples and links. Can someone create a read-only Grafana folder and add the oncall group?
miguel: Done — folder created and SSO groups invited :thumbsup:
anita: I'll stub the customer runbook and attach dashboard UID abcD-Efgh (and add note about expected labels: cluster, env, customer_id)
jess: Thanks all — closing the loop. If anything starts spiking ping @sre_oncall
